description: The release contains municipal sports-event spreadsheets for 2016–2017, with dates, times, names, venues, organisers and estimated attendance. The ILU relationship catalogue explicitly identifies these agendas as inputs to contextual public-transport models and bike-sharing forecasting. Estimated participation is a planning attribute and is not treated as observed ridership. Source format labels differ between xlsx in the native description and xls in catalogue metadata; the retained format is spreadsheet without an asserted exact workbook version. No contact lists or spreadsheet values were inspected. Coverage is limited to the source-described systems and experiments. The related Zenodo deposit provides descriptive metadata, with open document or data access and licence label cc-zero. Document rights do not establish software rights or access to the underlying observations. Only full descriptive metadata, file inventories and the project metadata catalogue were reviewed; no underlying measurements, code, paper or model archive was opened.
